title: Deep Learning-Based Prediction of HER2 Status from Whole-Brain MRI in Breast Cancer Brain Metastases
abstract: arXiv:2610.32774v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Purpose: Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) status is a key biomarker relevant for prognostication and treatment decision making in metastatic breast cancer. Thus, the aim of this work was to explore whether HER2 status can be predicted directly from whole-brain post-contrast T1-weighted (T1w) MRI scans in breast cancer brain metastases (BCBM) using deep learning, and whether providing explicit tumour segmentation information improves prediction.   Methods: Using the publicly available BCBM-Radiogenomics dataset, we analysed 135 patients, including 70 HER2+ and 65 HER2- patients. Three approaches were implemented and evaluated: a conventional radiomics model, a simple fully convolutional network (SFCN) using T1w MRI scans alone, and an SFCN using T1w MRI scans with an expert-derived tumour mask as an additional input channel. translated_abstract: 目的：人表皮生长因子受体2（HER2）状态是转移性乳腺癌预后评估和治疗决策的关键生物标志物。因此，本研究旨在探索能否利用深度学习直接从乳腺癌脑转移瘤（BCBM）的全脑对比增强T1加权（T1w）MRI扫描中预测HER2状态，以及提供显式肿瘤分割信息是否能改善预测效果。方法：利用公开可用的BCBM-Radiogenomics数据集，我们分析了135名患者，其中HER2阳性70名，HER2阴性65名。研究实现并评估了三种方法：传统影像组学模型、仅使用T1w MRI扫描的简单全卷积网络（SFCN），以及使用T1w MRI扫描并将专家标注的肿瘤掩膜作为附加输入通道的SFCN。结果：影像组学模型获得了受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究探索利用深度学习从乳腺癌脑转移瘤的全脑T1加权MRI中直接预测HER2状态，并评估了引入专家肿瘤分割信息作为额外输入通道能否提升预测性能。
en_tdlr: This study explores the use of deep learning to directly predict HER2 status from whole-brain T1-weighted MRI in breast cancer brain metastases, and evaluates whether providing expert-derived tumour segmentation as an additional input channel improves prediction performance.
